decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The roof extension consisting of a gable end extending 4.13m from the existing hipped ridgeline, being 2.7m high and having a base width of 8.1m, with a volume of 14.90m3, as well as a rear dormer with dimensions of 3.7m deep, 2.35m high with a width of 5.5m, that adds 23.91m3 together with the existing garage, which has a volume of 30.05m3, providing a total extension volume of 68.86m3 to the original dwellinghouse, qualifies as Class B permitted development within Part 1 of Schedule 2 of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 and therefore, does not require planning permission.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a roof extension to dwellinghouse.
